identity: 崇明学宫东牌坊（题名面待核）
legacy_id_limit: The retained chaozong asset identifier is for compatibility with the existing queue. It does not establish that a photographed 朝宗 plaque belongs to the physical east portal or to either accepted model face.
status: Completed independent east structural candidate using shared geometry assumptions; actual export checks passed; both plaque faces blank
scope: Physical east portal identified by official text. All geometry parameters reuse the West Paifang candidate assumptions based on common photographed structure; this is not proof of identical physical dimensions/details or acceptance of one identified portal in complete front/back views.

documented.relative_position: Physical eastern of the two portals in front of Lingxing Gate, per the 2021 official east/west text
documented.upper_structure: Brick and timber above stone columns
documented.measurement_endpoints: Not specified for pillar width, pillar spacing or the distance between the two portals
documented.wind_bells: The text states they can hang from upturned corners; an installed bell at every corner is not visually verified

inscriptions.pairing_status: Unresolved source-group discrepancy; exchanging observer left/right does not resolve it. No presumed same-date front/back identity chain.
inscriptions.rendered_inscription_status: Both plaque faces blank; no carved, painted or texture-based lettering
inscriptions.visual_hypothesis_limit: A moderate contextual hypothesis links the near 朝宗 view to the panorama left/west portal and the near 学海 view to the panorama right/east portal. It does not establish capture dates, georeferenced identity or corrected historical title groups.

interpretations.local_axes: Local X is the column-spacing direction, interpreted as north-south. Local Y is the open passage direction, interpreted as east-west. This is an orientation choice, not a measured heading or city registration.
interpretations.column_spacing_limit: The source does not distinguish clear, axis or outside spacing; axis spacing is chosen for this candidate.
interpretations.foot_depth_limit: The 1.6 m source phrase is interpreted as support depth along local Y. It is not claimed as the measured cross-section of each stone shaft.
interpretations.attached_foot_blocks: Estimated geometry inspired by visible attached stone blocks; rear and buried foundations unverified
interpretations.roof_scheme: Three independent roof units: one raised central canopy and two lower side canopies, at two eave levels. Do not substitute a continuous double-eaved hall roof.
interpretations.roof_corner_limit: Four modeled corners per unit match the documentary total; not all twelve corners are individually visible or measured in the source photographs.

central_roof.ridge_limit: Roof surface baseline excludes added ridge cap and simplified corner ornaments.

side_roofs.ridge_limit: Roof surface baseline excludes added ridge cap and simplified corner ornaments.

interpretations.height_limit: Explicit model estimate from the approximate 9米多 description. 三丈 is not converted into a fixed measured 10 m height.
interpretations.timber: Thick beams, dense layered curved bracket arms, bearing blocks and diagonal/outward braces; counts, sections, joinery and hidden load paths are estimated.
interpretations.carving: Original simplified openwork and raised wave-pattern bands. No exact dragon, phoenix, ridge-beast or calligraphic reproduction.
interpretations.materials: Approximate light stone, dark red-brown timber and grey tile, using original flat colours and roughness; no photographic texture sampling.
interpretations.rear_and_hidden_parts: Rear roof slopes, column-back supports, hidden roof junctions and all unobserved carving are estimated.
interpretations.roof_assumptions_limit: Rear slopes mirror front by authoring assumption; strongly upturned curves and repeated bracket density are not individually measured or photo-accepted.
interpretations.roof_end_shape_limit: All three use simplified curved four-slope geometry; hip-end shapes are estimated, not a confirmed measured roof classification.

actual_export_envelope.coordinate_system: glTF metres; X across posts, Y up, Z passage direction
actual_export_envelope.measurement_limit: Computed from this East Paifang export. Shared geometry assumptions do not verify matching real portal dimensions; not site measurements. Includes foot blocks, fascia and highest simplified corner ornaments.

viewer_scope: Exterior navigation around a closed perimeter outside the model envelope. The geometry has an open space between columns, but the webpage does not claim passage-through or climbing interaction.
omitted: West portal and surveyed placement of the 33 m interval
Lingxing gates, courtyard walls, granite path and measured ground
Trees, parking signs, publicity boards and other scene objects
All plaque lettering and exact dragon/phoenix/ridge-beast motifs
Unverified hanging wind-bell configuration and buried foundations
reference_period: Historical text and 2021/2023 article references; individual image capture dates and a 2026 condition are not verified.
code_reuse_limit: All modeled geometry and the construction/export workflow reuse the West Paifang candidate with explicit shared assumptions. This does not prove identical real dimensions, roof shape, carving, brackets or hidden supports; the East Paifang keeps a distinct documentary identity and blank plaques.

shared_assumption_model.identity: 崇明学宫西牌坊（题名面待核）
shared_assumption_model.scope: All East Paifang candidate geometry reuses the West Paifang candidate parameters and authoring assumptions: stone shafts and feet, open passage, blank plaque frames, three roof units, elevations, curves, repeated brackets, simplified carvings, colours and hidden/rear supports. This is a shared modeling assumption, not independent evidence that the two physical portals have identical dimensions or details. Separate east identity comes from official text; neither legacy asset name binds a photographed inscription face. Both plaques remain blank and no invented details are added to distinguish the candidates.
